headline: September folder booked. SKHY/SPCX SMSF calls on. Memory still bid.
lede: Weekend clerk. September Drive + Aug Webull monthlies reconciled. 04-Sep SMSF bought SKHY 182.5 Sep-11, SPCX 145 Mar-27 and SKHY 160 Jan-27 x2. Book A$3.734m on Friday’s tape. Joint IBKR qty match.

items.title: Broadcom Q3 FY26: US$29.6b, AI semis US$16.7b, Q4 US$34.8b
items.what: Beat street ~US$29.4b / $3.24 with adj. EPS $3.32. AI semiconductor revenue US$16.7b (+221% y/y, +54% q/q). Q4 revenue guide ~US$34.8b (street ~US$35.0b); AI semis guided to US$21.7b. Hock Tan: FY27 AI revenue ~US$115b, path to ~US$230b FY28. Stock shrugged — now 357.9 vs 369.7 last mark.
items.impact: The print is a beat; the Q4 guide is the fade. AVGO SMSF now 100sh after selling 20. Do not chase. The FY27 AI number is the multi-year hold for AVGO/NVDA/TSM/SEMI, not a one-session add.

items.title: Nvidia buys Hugging Face for US$12.9b
items.what: Signed Thursday. Jensen: platform stays open, Nvidia compute not required. ~18m developers, 3m models. Cash/ecosystem, not Q3 revenue.
items.impact: Confirms the software/open-model bid around NVDA. Too small vs the chip run-rate to re-rate the book. Hold the NVDA stock and LEAPs.

items.title: Cybercab launch, then a federal probe
items.what: Launch Thursday; within 24 hours a US probe and TSLA −5.9% Friday (354.08). Still the largest satellite line on the desk.
items.impact: Do not add. Robotaxi remains 2027+ optionality. Size is already large vs the rest of the satellite sleeve.

items.title: Memory and connectivity ripped Friday
items.what: MU 1016.6 (+6.1%), SNDK 1740 (+11.9%), SKHY 177 (+8.1%), DRAM 59.69, ALAB 310.4 (+9.8%), MRVL 223.6 (+7.0%). Tight HBM/DRAM + a rebound after Wednesday’s risk-off.
items.impact: Helps the SMSF memory sleeve and the new SKHY calls (Sep-18 180 is a two-week lot — watch expiry). Do not chase Friday’s close.

risks: Stronger August jobs (~162k vs ~55k) lifted September hike odds toward 50% — duration and high-multiple AI can fade.
TSLA is still the biggest satellite line and just lost the Cybercab tape.
SKHY 180 call expires 18-Sep — a two-week lot, not a LEAP.
AVGO Q4 guide a touch light; the stock has not paid the print.
rewards: AVGO FY27 AI ~US$115b and NVDA Hugging Face keep the core AI backlog intact.
Memory tightness (MU/SNDK/DRAM/SKHY) is the same throttle Nvidia cited last week.
SMSF raised cash: CRDO 104 and AVGO 20 sold, VRT 260C and the SPCX Nov-26 vertical closed.
